To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
SMEs can be characterized in terms of their sustainability orientation and that the innovation practices of these firms are contingent upon this sustainability orientation.
SOI of SMEs can be described by a framework consisting of four strategic sustainability behaviors and four innovation practices.

the strategic sustainability behavior of SMEs ranges from resistant, through reactive and anticipatory, to innovation based and rooted in sustainability, and that the innovation practices of these companies include eco-innovations, product, process and organizational innovations, as well as innovation of the innovation process itself.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question how to stimulate SMEs to engage in SOIs.
the development of a more integrated understanding of SOIs and their innovation practices in SMEs.
the role SMEs have for sustainable development, and how their strategic sustainability behavior and innovation practices can be improved.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the research on SMEs is still in its infancy, but it is gaining momentum.
SOIs are not a panacea but a means to an end.
research on SOIs of small and medium sized firms has made significant progress, yet it has also been fragmented and is still far from being conclusive.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

SOIs of SME can be a major contributor to sustainable development, but that more research is needed to understand the innovation process and to develop appropriate tools to support SMEs to engage in SOIs.
the innovation practices and strategic sustainability behavior of SMEs are not only contingent but also dynamic.
the literature on SOIs of small firms is still in its infancy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
SOIs of SME are a promising research area for the future.
the innovation capacity of SMEs is a crucial factor to foster sustainable development.
SMEs can be a key driver for sustainability in the future, but they require support in the innovation process and the development of their capabilities for SOIs.
